speaker: R
text: A truck with no speaker sings outside my window at 3 a.m. every night.

speaker: R
text: Mom says we never take its free ice cream.

speaker: R
text: The next day, he held his cone all through lunch without taking a bite.

speaker: R
text: It didn't melt, even on the hot slide.

speaker: R
text: When he walked past me, I heard the truck's song.

speaker: R
text: A week later, my teacher had a cone too.

speaker: R
text: During our spelling test, she hummed the tune while she wrote.

speaker: R
text: She even hit the same wrong note the truck always hits.

speaker: R
text: Last night, the truck stopped outside our house.

speaker: R
text: The engine went quiet, but the song kept getting closer.

speaker: R
text: Mom opened my bedroom door holding two cones.

speaker: R
text: The whole truck song came out, bells and all.

speaker: R
text: She held the spare cone out to me.

speaker: R
text: I was supposed to be its next speaker.
